Aspen Acres, Custer County. CIMT (RM Team 3). Twenty miles southwest of Pueblo, CO. Timber. Minimal 
fire behavior with creeping, flanking and backing. Numerous structures threatened. Area and road closures in 
effect. Precipitation occurred over the fire area yesterday. 
 
Gold Mountain, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. CIMT (RM Team 1). Two miles north 
of Ouray, CO. Grass, brush and timber. Minimal fire behavior with backing, creeping and smoldering. 
Numerous structures and critical infrastructure threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
Elk, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. Transfer of command from CIMT (NW Team 8) to 
CIMT (RM Team 1) will occur tomorrow. Seven miles northwest of Lake City, CO. Timber, heavy slash and 
grass. Minimal fire behavior with creeping and smoldering. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Precipitation 
occurred over the fire area yesterday. 
 
Willow, Pike and San Isabel NF, USFS. Six miles west of Leadville, CO. Brush, closed timber litter and timber. 
Minimal fire behavior with smoldering and creeping. Residences and communication infrastructure threatened. 
Area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
Ferris, San Juan NF, USFS. Seven miles east of Cahone, CO. Timber and brush. Minimal fire behavior with 
smoldering. Area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
Kohns, Campbell County. Twenty miles northeast of Gillette, WY. Grass and brush. Minimal fire behavior. 
Structures threatened.
